finding: Derived and numerically verified Candidate R9 coupled active-set Newton formulation for C3 continuation: all 4 Jacobian blocks (K_uu, K_ud, K_du, K_dd) match finite differences with relative error < 1e-9. Solved +1 nm increment in 2 Newton iterations satisfying discrete mechanical equilibrium (res_u = 8.39e-16 kN <= 1e-4 kN), physical phase stationarity (res_d = 0.0 <= 1e-6 kN/mm), active-set KKT complementarity (0 violations), and zero healing. Proved that Abaqus Standard's 2-element UEL architecture yields block-diagonal tangent matrices (K_ud = K_du = 0), establishing that genuine coupled continuation requires either a unified 12-DOF UEL or external coupled driving.
